# Awesome Directories - Full Documentation

> Curated directory aggregator web application helping indie hackers, bootstrappers, and solopreneurs discover 300+ verified product launch directories for SaaS products.

## Quick Reference

- Website: https://awesome-directories.com
- Repository: https://github.com/awesome-directories/awesome-directories
- License: Apache 2.0
- Concise Version: /llms.txt

## Project Overview

### Core Value Proposition

- Curated, verified directories updated weekly
- Advanced filtering by Domain Rating (DR), category, pricing, and link type
- User authentication with favorites and project-based submission tracking
- Directory detail pages with related directories, ratings, and reviews
- User directory submission system with review workflow and email notifications
- Project management for tracking submissions across multiple products
- Automated SEO metrics updates via Ahrefs API and Supabase Edge Functions
- Comprehensive statistics page with interactive charts
- Blog with SEO-optimized content, tags, search, and RSS feed

### Key Features

1. **Directory Listing**: 300+ curated directories with filtering and search
2. **User Authentication**: Google/GitHub OAuth via Supabase
3. **Favorites System**: Save and manage favorite directories
4. **Submission Tracking**: Track which directories you've submitted products to
5. **Directory Submissions**: Submit new directories for admin review
6. **Ratings & Reviews**: Rate directories 1-5 stars and leave comments
7. **Blog System**: Markdown/MDX posts with search, tags, and comments
8. **Statistics Dashboard**: Interactive charts showing directory analytics
9. **Email Notifications**: Automated emails for submissions, approvals, rejections

---

## Technology Stack

### Frontend

| Technology | Version | Purpose |
|------------|---------|---------|
| Astro.js | 5.16.0 | Static Site Generation with Content Collections |
| Vue.js 3 | Latest | Interactive components (Composition API, islands) |
| Tailwind CSS | 4.1.17 | Utility-first CSS |
| TypeScript | - | Type safety (ES modules) |
| Chart.js | 4.5.1 | Interactive statistics charts |
| Pagefind | 1.4.0 | Static search indexing for blog |

### Backend & Services

| Service | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| Supabase | PostgreSQL database, Auth, Realtime, Edge Functions |
| Resend | Transactional email (approval, rejection, welcome emails) |
| Listmonk | Self-hosted newsletter (newsletter.meysam.io) |
| Ahrefs API | SEO metrics (DR, traffic) via Apify |
| Giscus | GitHub Discussions for blog comments |
| Pirsch | Privacy-first analytics (optional) |

### Build & Deploy

| Tool | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| Bun | Package manager (primary) |
| Vite | Build tool via Astro |
| GitHub Actions | CI/CD pipeline |
| GitHub Pages | Production hosting |
| Netlify | PR preview deployments |

## Architecture Patterns

### Build-time vs Runtime Data Flow

```
BUILD-TIME:
Supabase DB → Astro Build → Static HTML + directories.json → GitHub Pages

RUNTIME:
User → Vue Component → /data/directories.json → Filtered Results
User → Auth/Favorite → Supabase API → Database Update
```

### Component Architecture

1. **Astro Components** (.astro): Server-rendered static content
2. **Vue Islands** (.vue): Client-side interactive features with `client:load`
3. **Composables**: Shared Vue Composition API logic
4. **Stores**: Minimal global state with Nanostores

### Data Strategy

| Data Type | Fetch Time | Storage |
|-----------|------------|---------|
| Directories list | Build-time | Static JSON |
| Blog posts | Build-time | Content Collections |
| Statistics | Build-time | Static JSON |
| User favorites | Runtime | Supabase |
| User submissions | Runtime | Supabase |
| Auth state | Runtime | Nanostores + localStorage |

---

## Database Schema

### Core Tables

#### directories
Primary table for all directory listings.

| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| id | uuid | Primary key |
| slug | text | URL-friendly identifier (unique) |
| name | text | Directory name |
| url | text | Directory website URL |
| description | text | Directory description |
| categories | text[] | Array of categories |
| pricing | text | free, paid, freemium |
| link_type | text | dofollow, nofollow, mixed |
| domain_rating | integer | Ahrefs DR score (0-100) |
| organic_traffic | integer | Monthly organic traffic |
| organic_keywords | integer | Ranking keywords count |
| helpful_count | integer | User helpfulness votes |
| average_rating | numeric | Aggregated rating (1-5) |
| rating_count | integer | Number of ratings |
| review_count | integer | Number of reviews |
| is_active | boolean | Active status |
| is_affiliate | boolean | Has affiliate link |
| affiliate_url | text | Affiliate URL if applicable |
| created_at | timestamp | Creation date |
| updated_at | timestamp | Last update |

#### user_favorites
User-saved directories.

| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| id | uuid | Primary key |
| user_id | uuid | References auth.users |
| directory_id | uuid | References directories |
| created_at | timestamp | When favorited |

#### pending_directories
User-submitted directories awaiting review.

| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| id | uuid | Primary key |
| user_id | uuid | Submitter |
| name | text | Directory name |
| url | text | Directory URL |
| description | text | Description |
| categories | text[] | Categories |
| status | text | pending, approved, rejected |
| admin_notes | text | Reviewer notes |
| reviewed_by | uuid | Admin who reviewed |
| notification_sent | boolean | Email sent flag |
| created_at | timestamp | Submission date |

#### projects
User projects for tracking submissions.

| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| id | uuid | Primary key |
| user_id | uuid | Project owner |
| name | text | Project name |
| url | text | Project URL |
| description | text | Project description |
| logo_url | text | Project logo |
| created_at | timestamp | Creation date |

#### project_submissions
Track which directories a project has been submitted to.

| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| id | uuid | Primary key |
| project_id | uuid | References projects |
| directory_id | uuid | References directories |
| status | text | not_started, in_progress, submitted, approved, rejected, featured |
| submission_link | text | Actual submission URL |
| notes | text | Personal notes |
| created_at | timestamp | Creation date |

#### directory_ratings
User ratings for directories.

| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| id | uuid | Primary key |
| user_id | uuid | Rater |
| directory_id | uuid | Directory rated |
| rating | integer | 1-5 stars |
| created_at | timestamp | When rated |

#### directory_reviews
User comments on directories.

| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| id | uuid | Primary key |
| user_id | uuid | Reviewer |
| directory_id | uuid | Directory reviewed |
| content | text | Review text |
| created_at | timestamp | When posted |

#### email_preferences
User email opt-out settings.

| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| id | uuid | Primary key |
| user_id | uuid | User reference |
| submission_updates | boolean | Opt-in for updates |
| welcome_emails | boolean | Opt-in for welcome |
| review_notifications | boolean | Opt-in for reviews |
| weekly_digest | boolean | Opt-in for digest |
| marketing_emails | boolean | Opt-in for marketing |

#### email_logs
Track all sent emails.

| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| id | uuid | Primary key |
| email_type | text | Type of email |
| email_to | text | Recipient |
| email_subject | text | Subject line |
| status | text | sent, failed |
| error_message | text | Error if failed |
| created_at | timestamp | When sent |

### Key Indexes

- `directories.categories` - GIN index for array queries
- `directories.domain_rating` - DESC index (nulls last)
- `directories.slug` - Unique index
- `directories.is_active` - Status filter
- `directories.pricing` - Pricing filter

### Row Level Security

- Enabled on user-specific tables (favorites, submissions, preferences)
- Public read access on directories table
- Users can only modify their own data

## Composables & Logic

### useDirectories.js

Client-side directory data management.

```javascript
// State
directories      // All directories from JSON
filteredDirectories  // After filters applied
loading, error   // Loading states

// Methods
loadDirectories()     // Fetch /data/directories.json
filterDirectories()   // Apply all active filters
searchDirectories(query)  // Text search
sortDirectories(sortBy)   // Sort by: helpful, dr, newest, alpha

// Filter Options
- categories: string[]
- drRange: [min, max]
- linkType: 'dofollow' | 'nofollow' | 'mixed'
- pricing: 'free' | 'paid' | 'freemium'
- searchQuery: string
```

### useAuth.js

Authentication state management.

```javascript
// State
user        // Current user object
session     // Supabase session
loading     // Auth loading state

// Methods
signInWithGoogle()   // Google OAuth
signInWithGithub()   // GitHub OAuth
signOut()            // Clear session
refreshSession()     // Refresh token
```

### useDirectory.js

Single directory operations.

```javascript
// Methods
addToFavorites(directoryId)
removeFromFavorites(directoryId)
isFavorite(directoryId)    // Check favorite status
getUserFavoriteIds()       // Get all user's favorites
```

### useProjects.js

Project and submission tracking.

```javascript
// State
projects, currentProject, projectSubmissions

// Project Methods
loadProjects()
createProject(data)
updateProject(id, data)
deleteProject(id)

// Submission Methods
loadProjectSubmissions(projectId)
upsertSubmission(data)
updateSubmissionStatus(id, status)
updateSubmissionLink(id, link)
deleteSubmission(id)
getSubmissionStats()  // Counts by status
```

## Routing

### Static Pages

| Route | File | Auth Required |
|-------|------|---------------|
| / | index.astro | No |
| /about | about.astro | No |
| /stats | stats.astro | No |
| /terms | terms.astro | No |
| /privacy | privacy.astro | No |
| /favorites | favorites.astro | Yes |
| /submissions | submissions.astro | Yes |
| /my-submissions | my-submissions.astro | Yes |
| /submit | submit.astro | Yes |
| /404 | 404.astro | No |

### Dynamic Routes

| Route | File | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| /directory/[slug] | directory/[slug].astro | Directory detail pages |
| /blog | blog/index.astro | Blog listing |
| /blog/[slug] | blog/[slug].astro | Individual posts |
| /blog/[...page] | blog/[...page].astro | Pagination |
| /blog/tags/[tag] | blog/tags/[tag].astro | Posts by tag |

### Dynamic Page Generation

Directory and blog pages use `getStaticPaths()`:

```javascript
// src/pages/directory/[slug].astro
export async function getStaticPaths() {
  const directories = await getAllDirectories();
  return directories.map(dir => ({
    params: { slug: dir.slug },
    props: { directory: dir }
  }));
}
```

## Development Guide

### Prerequisites

- Bun (primary) or Node.js 18+
- Supabase account
- GitHub account (for Giscus comments)

### Quick Start

```bash
# Install dependencies
bun install

# Copy environment file
cp .env.example .env

# Start dev server
bun start     # http://localhost:3000

# Build for production
bun run build

# Preview production
bun run preview
```

### Environment Variables

Required:
```env
VITE_SUPABASE_URL=https://xxx.supabase.co
VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=<anon-key>
```

Optional:
```env
VITE_PIRSCH_SITE_ID=<analytics-id>
VITE_GITHUB_REPO=awesome-directories/awesome-directories
VITE_GITHUB_REPO_ID=<repo-id>
VITE_GITHUB_CATEGORY=Announcements
VITE_GITHUB_CATEGORY_ID=<category-id>
PUBLIC_PREVIEW=true  # Show draft posts
```

Edge Functions:
```env
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=<service-role-key>
RESEND_API_KEY=<resend-api-key>
FROM_EMAIL=notifications@domain.com
APIFY_API_TOKEN=<apify-token>
```

---

## Build & Deployment

### Build Process

1. Astro fetches all directories from Supabase
2. Static HTML pages generated for all routes
3. `directories.json` saved to `public/data/`
4. `stats.json` generated with analytics data
5. Pagefind indexes blog content
6. Assets compressed (Gzip + Brotli)

### GitHub Actions Workflow

**On Pull Request:**
1. Build with `PUBLIC_PREVIEW=true`
2. Deploy to Netlify for preview
3. Comment preview URL on PR
4. Run link checker

**On Push to Main:**
1. Build production site
2. Deploy to GitHub Pages

### Performance Optimizations

- Static Site Generation (no SSR overhead)
- Aggressive code splitting (vendor chunks)
- Terser minification (console removed)
- LightningCSS minification
- Gzip level 9 + Brotli level 11
- Sharp image optimization
- Lighthouse target: 95+

---

## Common Tasks

### Adding a New Directory

Via submission form:
1. User submits at /submit
2. Stored in `pending_directories`
3. Admin reviews in Supabase dashboard
4. On approval, moved to `directories` table
5. Rebuild site to reflect changes

### Adding a Blog Post

1. Create `.md` or `.mdx` file in `src/content/blog/`
2. Add frontmatter:

```markdown
---
title: "Post Title"
description: "SEO description"
date: 2025-01-15
tags: ["SEO", "Marketing"]
author: "Author Name"
coverImage: "/covers/image.jpg"
draft: false
---

Content here...
```

3. Rebuild site

### Database Migrations

```bash
# Create migration
supabase migration new <name>

# Apply locally
supabase db reset

# Push to remote
supabase db push
```

### Updating SEO Metrics

Automated via Supabase pg_cron calling `update-seo-data` Edge Function.

Manual:
```bash
curl -X POST https://project.supabase.co/functions/v1/update-seo-data \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer SECRET" \
  -d '{"batchSize": 10}'
```

---

## Conventions & Best Practices

### Code Style

- Astro components for static content
- Vue components only for interactivity
- Vue 3 Composition API with `<script setup>`
- Tailwind CSS utility classes
- Mobile-first responsive design
- TypeScript where applicable

### State Management

- Nanostores for minimal global state (auth only)
- Composables for component-level state
- No Vuex/Pinia (too heavy)
- Client-side caching where needed

### Security

- Row Level Security on all user tables
- Never commit `.env` files
- OAuth handled by Supabase
- HTTPS enforced by GitHub Pages
- Edge Functions validate authorization

### SEO

- All content in static HTML
- Structured data (Schema.org)
- Open Graph + Twitter Cards
- Automatic sitemap generation
- Proper canonical URLs

### Accessibility

- WCAG 2.1 AA target
- Semantic HTML structure
- Keyboard navigation
- Screen reader compatible

### Performance

- Minimize client-side JavaScript
- Lazy load Vue islands
- Optimize images
- Cache static assets
- Monitor bundle size

---

## Troubleshooting

### Build Errors

- Check Astro build output for details
- Verify environment variables are set
- Ensure Supabase is accessible

### Runtime Issues

- Browser console for client errors
- Vue DevTools in development
- Supabase dashboard for DB logs

### Common Fixes

- `bun install` after pulling changes
- Clear `.astro` cache if builds fail
- Rebuild after database changes
